results.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ wins Oscar for best animated film | AP News
highlights:
“KPop Demon Hunters” won the Academy Award for best animated feature film on Sunday, capping a culturally defining run that has placed the musical-action movie atop both box-office and music charts.
...
The film’s victory came as little surprise to those following awards season. The other nominees — “Arco,” “Elio,” “Little Amélie or the Character of Rain” and “Zootopia 2" — had racked up few prizes at the shows leading up to the Oscars. “KPop Demon Hunters” won big at many of the precursors, including the Producers Guild Awards and the Golden Globes.

results.title: 'KPop Demon Hunters' Wins Oscar for Best Animated Movie
results.author: Jazz Tangcay
highlights:
'KPop Demon Hunters' Wins Oscar for Best Animated Movie
...
KPop Demon Hunters' Wins Oscar for Best Animated Movie
...
“ KPop Demon Hunters” took home the Oscar for best animated feature at Sunday night’s Academy Awards. Netflix’s most-watched movie in history beat “Arco,” “Elio,” “Little Amélie or the Character of Rain” and “Zootopia 2” in the category.
...
The “KPop Demon Hunters” winning streak has been unstoppable. It won for best animated film at the Golden Globes, the Critics’ Choice Awards, PGA Awards and it took home 10 Annie Awards. The film, produced by Sony Animation, was directed by Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans, and produced by Michelle L.M. Wong. With the win, Kang and Wong make history as the first female Asian winners in best animated feature.

results.title: 'One Battle After Another' triumphs at Oscars, 'Sinners' makes history | AP News
highlights: As expected, the Netflix sensation “KPop Demon Hunters,” 2025’s most-watched film, won best animated feature, as well as best song for “Golden.” It was a big win for Netflix but a more qualified victory for the movie’s producer, Sony Pictures. Though it developed and produced the film, Sony sold “KPop Demon Hunters” to the streaming giant instead of giving it a theatrical release.

As widely predicted, Sony Pictures Animation and Netflix’ record-breaking KPop Demon Hunters took home the Best Animated Oscar on Sunday. The Academy Award win for the animated feature, which continues to be Netflix’s most-watched movie, came on the heels of the movie winning all the other major animation awards of the year, including the Golden Globe for Best Animated Feature and 10 Annie Awards.
